result.summary: The page layout is generally intact, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel contains a duplicated restaurant card that looks like a data or rendering bug.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first two cards are identical duplicates of 'Green Bowl Poké' — same photo, same '15-25 min' badge, and same '€0.90 delivery' text — so the row shows the same restaurant twice instead of distinct options.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the carousel data so each restaurant appears only once; if these are genuinely separate locations, give each card a distinct image and location-specific details so they are visually distinguishable.
